_: The ticket packs sold for real money (docs/ECONOMY.md → Ticket packs). One source for the phone (TicketShop) and the Worker (store_data.ts): the ids are the App Store / Play / RevenueCat product ids, `tickets` is what the server credits per sale, `priceUsd` the US tier shown until the store reports the player's own price.
_entitlements: One-time purchases the player OWNS (docs/ECONOMY.md → Remove ads): `key` is the RevenueCat entitlement the product is attached to; the Worker books an entitlements row per sale, revokes it on refund and moves it on a TRANSFER.
